scope_review: Learner drives an ordinary passenger car. This sign affects that car driver directly; no specialist vehicle operation is taught.
scenario: Rural open two-way road with fields, normal car roughly 90 metres ahead in our lane, clear visibility. No measurements or arrows drawn on the road.
novelty_review: Numeric prescribed minimum spacing instead of the existing general two-second following rule; no B17-linked situation exists.

fr.question_text: Quel intervalle minimal ce panneau m’impose-t-il avec le véhicule qui me précède ?
fr.answer_d: Aucun intervalle si la chaussée est sèche.
fr.explanation: Le panneau B17 impose un intervalle au moins égal à la valeur indiquée, ici 70 m. Je garde donc au minimum cette distance avec le véhicule devant moi et je l’augmente si la vitesse, la météo ou la visibilité l’exigent.

en.question_text: What minimum gap does this sign require between my car and the vehicle ahead?
en.answer_d: No gap if the road is dry.
en.explanation: Sign B17 requires a gap at least as large as the displayed distance, here 70 m. I therefore keep at least this distance from the vehicle ahead and increase it when speed, weather or visibility require more.
